queries: TheAgentCompany benchmark 2025 best agent completes 30% of tasks
Remote Labor Index agents automation rate October 2025
Gartner June 2025 agentic AI projects canceled agent washing

sources_considered.why: Analyst release on agentic AI projects (25 June 2025). The page refused the request, so nothing from it is used.

receipt.public_excerpt: in 2025, we may see the first AI agents “join the workforce” and materially change the output of companies.

evidence_items.explanation: Early in 2025, OpenAI's CEO said AI agents may 'join the workforce' that year. This shows agents promoted as transformative at the start of 2025. It is a company statement about its own field, not a test of agents.

evidence_items.locator: Sam Altman, 'The Gentle Singularity', personal blog

receipt.public_excerpt: 2025 has seen the arrival of agents that can do real cognitive work; writing computer code will never be the same.

evidence_items.explanation: In June 2025, OpenAI's CEO said 2025 had seen agents that can do real cognitive work. This shows the promotion continuing mid-year. It is a company claim, not an independent test; its example, writing code, is one use.

receipt.public_excerpt: the most competitive agent can complete 30% of tasks autonomously.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent benchmark of agents on tasks from a simulated software company, revised in September 2025: the best agent completed 30% of tasks on its own, and harder long-horizon tasks were still beyond reach. Simpler tasks were often solved. This is a preprint.

receipt.public_excerpt: Today we’re launching AgentKit, a complete set of tools for developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and optimize agents.

evidence_items.explanation: In October 2025, OpenAI launched a product line for building and deploying agents. This shows agents still being promoted in the last quarter of 2025. It is a company announcement, not a test of agents.

receipt.public_excerpt: AI agents perform near the floor on RLI, with the highest-performing agent achieving an automation rate of 2.5%.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent benchmark of real, paid remote-work projects across many sectors, published 30 October 2025. The best agent completed 2.5% of projects to the required standard. This is a preprint.

unresolved_gaps: No test from December 2025 is part of this record; the latest test is from 30 October 2025.
Agent use in narrow areas such as coding is not measured here; the speaker excepted very narrow use cases.
